summary: Implemented a background-music hook that plays a looping static audio file, persists enable/disable state in localStorage, and added a header icon button to toggle music. However, the diff does not show the required static audio asset being added under frontend/public, the UI control lacks a visible English label (icon-only), and the autoplay-blocked state (needsUserGesture) is not surfaced to provide a clear user path when autoplay is blocked.

missing_requirements.requirement: Serve the background music as a static frontend asset by adding an audio file under frontend/public (e.g., frontend/public/assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3) and playing it via a stable /assets/... URL.
missing_requirements.reason: The hook references /assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3 and includes a note that the file must be manually added, but the diff does not show any added file under frontend/public/assets/audio.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an accessible music control UI with an English label such as “Music: On/Off” (or equivalent) that is clearly discoverable and keyboard accessible.
missing_requirements.reason: Header adds an icon-only button with aria-labels, but no visible English label text like “Music: On/Off” is shown; acceptance criteria explicitly calls for label text.

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide a clear path to start music via the music toggle control when autoplay is blocked, without errors or intrusive prompts.
missing_requirements.reason: Autoplay blocking is detected via needsUserGesture in the hook, but the UI does not use or display this state, so there is no explicit in-app indication/path beyond an unlabeled icon button.
